audit_card_dispositions.evidence: The public durable controller selects exact application/instance identity, typed state and entries, contiguous revisions, exact dedupe, a closed decision value, and one-command suspension.
No current transition needs independent commands; no sequence, execution cursor, dependency graph, or batch failure path remains.
Exact typed outcomes distinguish business values, traps, denial, known failure, timeout/cancellation classes, and unknown visibility; retry/cancel are semantic events and instance ordering is serial.
The retained workload needs no time, randomness, network, child process, or live external-resource value; ambient routes remain absent.

One persisted already-narrow activation grant, explicit configuration, typed CLI requests, isolated instance namespaces, separate limits, full records, HEAD, retained history, replay, and fault-state tests close the workload.
The trusted in-process executor is documented honestly; no worker or process boundary would provide a current security property.
Prototype compaction only after measured history bytes or replay work cross two recorded operational thresholds; unresolved outcomes and dedupe receipts must remain exact.
A store-wide lock and exact bases give deterministic competing-writer behavior; validate-only shares preparation; immutable records/outcomes provide bounded audit.
Application binding is immutable and incompatible state currently creates a new instance; reopen only for a concrete continuity-preserving migration consumer.

Application format 3 directly cut over; a directory owns mutable instance authority and embeds exact validated application bytes, while immutable application graphs remain transferable without a mutable store.

Release format 1 and current nominal products/sums/functions suffice; no effect interface, registry, authenticity system, text, sequence, map, generics, recursive data, closures, or new package hierarchy has a current consumer.
Existing strict public values, stable errors, explicit-frame interpreter, verified Core boundary, managed immutable bytes, and allocate-new oracle remain the complete semantic path.
No measured complete-operation bottleneck justifies executable caches, serialized IR, JIT, or native application code.

Workspace snapshots/scans, consumed global workspace catalogue, command-local instance contract, current document/context/apply surfaces, compact CLI, and direct session topology remain coherent; no second schema authority was introduced.
No product consumer remained; daemon, transport, client, binary, tests, exports, and documentation were deleted together.

One authoring session plus exact short-lived commands used 41 processes and one Engine; stable root policy stayed 21,881 bytes and instance-local work uses 1,777-byte help rather than the 136,796-byte global schema.
Reopen model routing, provider benchmark, and weak-model claims only with a stable harness exposing model identity, multiple attempts, token classes, corrections, and deterministic task oracles.

Stateful applications require exact tests for event and resume entries; deterministic generators enumerate codec mutations, boundaries, and finite publication states without adding a property-test dependency.
cargo-fuzz was unavailable; add maintained targets only when coverage-guided runs are available or decoder complexity grows, and convert every finding to a deterministic regression.

Nightly Miri passed the new instance unit/fault scope with filesystem isolation disabled; finite Rust model tests enumerate retained publication and activation boundaries. Sanitizers and external formal tools were not run.
Support remains explicitly Linux x86-64 under a trusted local POSIX-like filesystem model; no portability, power-loss, hostile-admin, or sandbox claim is made.

Deterministic artifacts, unchanged dependency set, curated public instance API, one binary, named module owners, generated agreement tests, bounded diagnostics/observations, one threat model, eight production examples, single documentation owners, and prompt cleanup form the retained direct cutover.
No external distribution operator exists; reopen packaging, signing, or update infrastructure only for a named installation consumer.

Old application success rejects; safe Rust incremental cutover won; tombstone deletion, bounded inspect/history, immutable application binding, and immutable narrow grants are the one active lifecycle.
The activation capability consumes no secrets and state confidentiality is explicitly absent beyond trusted local host permissions; no secret or encryption machinery remains.

The fake and production activation executors share exact typed contracts; reconciliation is explicit; no-ops publish, terminality is semantic, policy is instance-bound, digest/command roles are narrow, evidence is bounded, the local operator is trusted, and inspect/history are derived review surfaces.
The long campaign is not normative and two older prompts were deleted; existing Cargo profiles and focused-before-full test locality remain adequate.
No CI workflow currently exists; add fast and scheduled scopes only when repository collaboration or a remote execution consumer exists.

Reusable release, binary canonicalizer, and durable controller own current workload evidence; this structured file owns campaign facts; roadmap, README, legacy searches, direct deletions, and the public verification matrix close acceptance.
